body: A3 fenced OFF by default (C6q behaviour): tegu_shadow_gpu_mode defaults to 0 = CPU decode; TEGU_SHADOW_GPU=1 (or anything but 0/ycbcr) enables GPU conversion, =ycbcr YCbCr only.
